title: Possible continuation/new indefinite phase of the SYNAES university-teacher stoppages
prior_month_activity: S002 search result says the stoppage series began 23 November 2021. S001 body says negotiations began in late August and describes 3-, 8-, and 21-day stoppages in the week before 3 January. The exact sequence and continuity are not established.
january_activity: S001 body says a 31 December general assembly decided to begin an indefinite strike on 3 January over teachers’ special-status decree and rector appointment. S003 search result reports a government–SYNAES agreement on 5 January; S019 search-only result says activities were to resume 10 January; S005 search-only result reports a petition seeking SYNAES leadership removal and a one-month truce. S006 body (published 12 January) reports that classes resumed “this Monday” after nearly two months of strike; some teachers and students attended, while dissenting teachers disputed the agreement as unconsulted, signed a petition to remove the bureau, and said they were observing a one-month truce. The S006 article does not give an attendance count or report a public protest.
episode_boundary_status: Unresolved: the January indefinite phase may follow prior-month stoppages in one ongoing episode, but exact earlier dates/breaks and the formal transition from the 3 January strike to the reported January truce/resumption are unclear.
reported_resolution: S006 body reports classes resumed on the Monday before its 12 January publication after nearly two months of strike and reports a one-month truce; it also describes internal disagreement. The article does not establish universal acceptance, a formal end date, or whether strike action stopped everywhere.
threshold_status: Unresolved: S001 describes workplace absence without a count or public assembly. S006 reports some instructors and students returning to classes, which is not a protest gathering and gives no participant count. No evidence establishes a public gathering of at least 50.
domestic_target: reported demands concern domestic public-university policy and rector appointment.
current_event_treatment: Retain as a possible prior-month continuation/January indefinite-strike onset lead, not a qualifying January event candidate on current evidence; do not infer crowd size or public-gathering status from closed universities or class resumption.
